title: In re Merehaven Party Supply LLC
forum: U.S. Bankruptcy Court, District of Minnesota; voluntary Chapter 7 asset case

timeline.event: Voluntary Chapter 7 petition and order for relief
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for thirteen days after signing

documents.title: Asset-case notice excerpt
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The voluntary Chapter 7 order for relief entered forty-nine days before the client workplan was signed. Ordinary trade claim; assets are expected. No government claim, Rule 3002(c) exception, later asset notice, or different bar date applies.

documents.title: Rack invoice packet
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Four spiral balloon racks remain unpaid, totaling $7,200. The packet includes signed delivery slips and omits bank details.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 3: Counsel will deliver the proof-of-claim draft and invoice attachment list. Delivery is due thirteen calendar days after the client workplan was signed. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Agreed delivery of balloon-rack claim draft

clientFacing.status: We are preparing the trade claim for your unpaid racks.
nextSteps: Confirm no credit memo reduced the balance.
Review the claim and delivery-slip attachments.
